releaseNotes: Move to @babel/parser 8.0.4. The architecture and repository-boundary validators now choose Babel plugins by file extension: .ts, .mts, and .cts parse with the typescript plugin alone, because Babel 8 reads a generic arrow such as <T>(value: T) => value as an unclosed JSX element when the jsx plugin is on.

Babel 8 stores a type parameter name as an Identifier node where Babel 7 stored a string. The boundary checker reads both, so apply<T extends CloudPublication>(value: T) stays flagged as cloud-publication authority.
Update the @anthropic-ai/sdk development dependency to 0.124.0 for the behavioral evals.
